title: C RPL root DAO ingest: bind authenticated origin, reject foreign host routes (fail-open today)
description: lichEN C root path accepts unauthenticated DAOs and foreign /128 host routes. Evidence: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c:735 lichen_rpl_dao_manager_process_dao_ex hardcodes authenticated=true; process_dao (rpl_dao_process.c:583-608) never receives the DAO source address so target==origin cannot be checked; extract_updates only enforces /128 + E=0 (rpl_dao_process.c:145-148,184). Rust reference: rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:520-526,633-650 (has_exact_origin_target: exactly one Target, prefix_len==128, prefix==origin, rejected before staged mutation and replay-floor commit at routing.rs:573). Python reference: python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py:869-886. Fix: add verified-origin (and authenticated) parameters through lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_routing.h:655,671; reject target != origin; fail closed when origin is absent; rewrite lichen/tests/rpl_routing/src/main.c fixtures (install_one/process_one :150-165 advertise foreign targets, DAO source not modeled). Acceptance: foreign /128, /0, broad prefixes rejected pre-mutation; host CMake suite (lichen/tests/rpl_routing) green with new deny cases; no regression in rpl_dao_sequence/rpl_dodag suites. Part of epic project-LICHEN-2auf.44.9.2 (decomposed).
